item.title: From Sticky Notes to Smart Answers: RAG Implementation with Spring Boot 4.1 & Spring AI 2.0
item.description: Learn how to build an intelligent note-taking application using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with Spring Boot 4.1, Spring AI 2.0, and Qdrant vector database. Includes Tool Calling for accurate expense calculations.
